check: Identify the authoritative ticket and correct entity/service
expected_evidence: Ticket reference; classification; entity and service scope
missing_information_action: Resolve record or ownership ambiguity before dependent work

check: Record the named internal case owner and alternate
expected_evidence: Protected person references and acknowledged coverage
missing_information_action: Assign internal coordination; a provider queue is insufficient

check: Confirm type and impact/urgency priority
expected_evidence: Request/incident/security/problem/change type; P1-P4 rationale and changes
missing_information_action: Route urgent security concerns immediately and reassess unsupported priority

check: Preserve original receipt and meaningful human response
expected_evidence: received_at_utc and human_response_at_utc with provenance; blank if not observed
missing_information_action: Recover supported timestamps; record unknown values without fabrication

check: Identify the service-level definition and calendar
expected_evidence: Adopted definition/version; calendar/time zone; separate update expectations
missing_information_action: Ask service owner to resolve applicability; do not invent a target

check: Carry elapsed time and previous timer events
expected_evidence: Elapsed wall and applicable service time; priority/assignment history; pause evidence; breaches
missing_information_action: Retain history and escalate timer discrepancies instead of resetting clocks

check: Summarize completed actions and results
expected_evidence: Action/attempt references; observed results; actor and time; approved scope
missing_information_action: Do not claim completion without evidence

check: Identify pending actions and uncertain outcomes
expected_evidence: In-flight operations; unknown target state; conflicting evidence; next check
missing_information_action: Inspect source state before retry or concurrent work

check: Identify action authority and approval dependencies
expected_evidence: Approver or standing-authority reference; limits; expiry; spend decision if applicable
missing_information_action: Pause reserved actions and contact authorized alternate

check: Provide a readable minimal evidence package
expected_evidence: Protected diagnostics and timeline references; recipient can access necessary evidence
missing_information_action: Use an approved restricted route; do not broaden visibility by default

check: Check sensitivity and recipient distribution
expected_evidence: Classification; verified recipients; sanitized vendor bundle; comment visibility check
missing_information_action: Remove unnecessary disclosures and seek specialist handling when needed

check: Identify the actual receiving person/team route
expected_evidence: Verified role/contact route; skill/access/capacity; requested escalation path
missing_information_action: Use functional or management alternate rather than blind reassignment

check: State the bounded requested action
expected_evidence: Specific diagnostic/action/decision; desired evidence; known exclusions
missing_information_action: Clarify the ask and scope before treating any response as acceptance

check: Verify current support coverage
expected_evidence: Supported hours/time zone; remote/on-call scope; independent route where needed
missing_information_action: Record the coverage gap and invoke the adopted fallback

check: Separate required physical work from remote support
expected_evidence: Physical step; competent authorized local resource; access and attendance basis
missing_information_action: Escalate missing onsite capability; do not infer it from remote availability

check: Verify entitlement and vendor case linkage when applicable
expected_evidence: Entitlement reference; recognized requester; provider case; approved charges or not applicable rationale
missing_information_action: Resolve support/commercial scope and preserve internal ownership

check: Prevent conflicting execution
expected_evidence: One execution coordinator; in-flight jobs reviewed; planned changes and rollback scope
missing_information_action: Hold competing actions under authority until state is reconciled

check: Update the requester through the approved route
expected_evidence: Impact/action/owner update reference; sent status; no unsupported ETA
missing_information_action: Send an authorized meaningful update and retain any delivery uncertainty

check: Set next update and review checkpoints
expected_evidence: Next update time with time zone; reviewer; blocker owner; escalation trigger
missing_information_action: Set the checkpoint using adopted rules before leaving work waiting

check: Confirm non-response and end-of-shift coverage
expected_evidence: Alternate route; escalation trigger; accepted shift cover or recorded unresolved gap
missing_information_action: Escalate failed response; do not assume unlimited outgoing availability

check: Obtain explicit scoped handoff acceptance
expected_evidence: Named recipient; accepted task; first action; next update; acceptance time and reference
missing_information_action: Keep unaccepted tasks with internal coordination and escalate the gap

check: Agree how the outcome will be checked
expected_evidence: System-of-record check; original user-task test; expected result; evidence and limitations
missing_information_action: Do not equate assignment or vendor closure with verified recovery

check: Retain residual problem/change/security work
expected_evidence: Linked records; remaining owner; accepted next action; review date; temporary-access cleanup
missing_information_action: Keep unfinished work visible and obtain accepted follow-up ownership

check: Reconcile restoration resolution closure and reopen handling
expected_evidence: restored_at_utc/resolved_at_utc/closed_at_utc only when observed; acceptance; reopen route; return handoff if needed
missing_information_action: Do not close as repaired on silence; preserve history on recurrence
